meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 安装后，NanoClaw 多了一个 Codex 代理后端。若把某个群组切换为 codex，该群组的对话将由 Codex 接管（规划、工具调用、MCP 工具、会话历史等），不再使用 Claude。不切换则保持原样。
howto.when: 仅当运行命令把群组 provider 设为 codex 并重启后，该群组才由 Codex 接管；或设置 `DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER` 为 codex 时，新建群组默认使用。安装本身不触发。

say.text: 把群组 alpha 切到 Codex 后端并重启。
say.note: 该群组之后的对话由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 以后新建的群组默认用 Codex。
say.note: 只影响之后创建的群组。

say.text: 帮我用 API 密钥完成 Codex 认证。
say.note: 认证成功后才能切换使用。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a Codex agent backend. Switching a group to codex makes Codex handle that group's planning, tool use, MCP tools, and session history instead of Claude. Without switching, nothing changes.
howto.when_en: Only after you run a command to set a group's provider to codex and restart does that group switch to Codex; or if DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER is set to codex, new groups use it by default. Installing alone triggers no change.

say_en.text: Switch group alpha to Codex backend and restart.
say_en.note: That group will then be handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Make new groups default to Codex.
Help me authenticate Codex with an API key.
say_en.note: Required before you can use it.
